changes: Removed the superseded local REST scanner implementation and references.
Kept the existing two-engine interface position and replaced the second engine with Nuclei.
Added a local CLI command builder, PostgreSQL worker, exact-attempt persistence, JSONL parser and PDF finalization.
Preserved OpenVAS, Nmap, Wazuh, ISO assessment, CISO Assistant and client workspaces.
nuclei_api_key_requirement: No API key is required for local open-source scans.
optional_cloud_authentication: Use nuclei -auth outside SecureScope when dashboard upload is intentionally enabled.
